topics.why_in_news: Union Cabinet approved India’s updated Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) for the 2031–2035 period to be submitted to the UNFCCC under the Paris Agreement framework.
prelims_quick_notes: NDCs are climate action commitments submitted under Paris Agreement.
Paris Agreement adopted under UNFCCC in 2015.
India focuses on climate justice and Common But Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR).
Targets include clean energy transition and emissions intensity reduction.
Supports renewable energy expansion and sustainable development.
Linked with net-zero target and energy transition goals.
NDCs updated periodically under global climate framework.
India emphasises balancing development needs with climate action.
important_facts: UNFCCC = United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change.
Paris Agreement aims to limit global temperature rise.
CBDR principle recognises historical responsibility of developed nations.
India targets 500 GW non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030.
exam_relevance: Important for International Relations, Environment and Climate Governance.
Useful for COP summits, climate finance and renewable energy topics.
Can be linked with sustainable development and global environmental governance.
prelims_traps: Paris Agreement operates under UNFCCC framework.
NDCs are nationally determined, not legally imposed externally.
Net-zero does not mean immediate zero emissions.
